title: 1990s meeting of EG&G head, Greer, Dick D'Amato and O'Donnell where UFOs were taken off the table
summary: UAPGerb tells of 1990s meeting of EG&G head, Greer, Dick D'Amato and O'Donnell where UFOs were taken off the table, about 1990s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there was a meeting set up between one of the heads of EG&G Edgarton German and Greer for one of them to meet with him Dick Damato

plain: UAPGerb, an online UFO researcher, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a meeting in the 1990s, passing on what a journalist named George Knapp told him. He says a meeting was set up between one of the heads of EG&G, a defense contractor, and Steven Greer, a campaigner for UFO disclosure, along with men named Dick D'Amato and Alfred O'Donnell, and that at this meeting UFOs were taken off the table as a subject. If true, it would suggest a contractor knew enough about UFOs to steer the talk away from them.
